calls.statement:
SELECT join_date, count(*) AS version_rows, count(DISTINCT member_id) AS members, count(DISTINCT member_key) AS keys,
  min(valid_from) AS min_vf, max(valid_from) AS max_vf, sum(CASE WHEN is_current THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cur
FROM dim_member
WHERE join_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-28' AND DATE '2026-10-08'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT (SELECT max(join_date) FROM dim_member) AS max_join,
 (SELECT max(valid_from) FROM dim_member) AS max_vf,
 (SELECT max(sale_date) FROM fact_sales_line) AS max_sale,
 (SELECT max(etl_loaded_at) FROM fact_sales_line) AS max_load,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM dim_member WHERE join_date = DATE '2026-10-03') AS rows_3oct,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT member_id) FROM dim_member WHERE join_date = DATE '2026-10-03') AS members_3oct,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT member_id) FROM dim_member WHERE member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member WHERE join_date = DATE '2026-10-03') AND join_date <> DATE '2026-10-03') AS conflicting_join,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(DISTINCT join_date)>1)) AS multi_join_members

SELECT m.home_store_id, s.store_name, s.region, s.close_date, count(*) AS n, min(m.valid_from) vf, max(m.valid_to) vt, sum(CASE WHEN m.marketing_consent THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) consent
FROM dim_member m LEFT JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_id = m.home_store_id AND s.is_current
WHERE m.join_date = DATE '2026-10-03'
GROUP BY 1,2,3,4 ORDER BY 1

FROM dim_date d LEFT JOIN dim_member m ON m.join_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.calendar_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-12' AND DATE '2026-10-04'
